sourceTitle: Lectures on Poetry Read in the Schools of Natural Philosophy at Oxford
description: "Lectures on Poetry" by Joseph Trapp is a scholarly work written in the mid-18th century. This collection of lectures, delivered at Oxford, explores the art and principles of poetry, emphasizing its significance and the depth of its craft.
